scope: Financial Wellbeing and Financial Capability programs

columns.baseline_funding: number, AUD. Recurrent base funding for the year, before that year's indexation, supplementation and one-off amounts
columns.indexation_funding: number, AUD, >= 0. Added in the year through indexation
columns.supplementation_funding: number, AUD, >= 0. Added in the year through supplementation
columns.one_off_funding: number, AUD, >= 0. Non-recurrent funding for the year
columns.note: string, optional. Shown in the funding event register

columns.year: string, must cover every year in funding.csv
columns.schads_increase_pct: number, percent increase applied from the previous year. First year is 0

derived.actual_funding: baseline + indexation + supplementation (+ one_off if selected)
derived.schads_indexed_funding: first-year baseline compounded by schads_increase_pct each year
